description: Every Polymarket feature the official Rust CLI ships, plus six novel commands no Polymarket tool offers
auth_description: Polymarket two-tier auth. POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY (Polygon EOA, hex 0x-prefixed) signs EIP-712 challenges + orders. Run `polymarket-pp-cli auth derive` once to mint L2 credentials (POLYMARKET_API_KEY/_SECRET/_PASSPHRASE), then export them for trading commands. Read commands work with no auth. POLYMARKET_FUNDER is only needed for Magic/proxy-wallet flows (SIGNATURE_TYPE 1 or 2). CHAIN_ID defaults to 137 (Polygon mainnet).

novel_features.name: Resolution radar
novel_features.description: List every market resolving in the next N days, ranked by your position value when a wallet is provided. Stops you missing redemption deadlines.

novel_features.name: Reward-yield ranker
novel_features.description: Rank reward-eligible markets by expected daily payout per dollar of capital at risk, given a target spread.

novel_features.name: Position drift snapshot
novel_features.description: For each position: entry price, current mid, min/max over a window, unrealized P&L drift, and a thawed/frozen flag based on current spread + book depth.

novel_features.name: Implied-probability diff
novel_features.description: Find tokens whose implied probability moved by more than a threshold over a time window. Supports a slug watchlist and arbitrary windows down to a few minutes.

novel_features.name: Frozen research bundle
novel_features.description: Export every market matching a tag, event, or id list as a portable zip: markets + events + tags + full price history + book snapshot + holders. bundle import rehydrates into a fresh SQLite.

novel_features.name: Redemption batch executor
novel_features.description: Discover every position in resolved markets and report the redeemable set with totals. In this build --broadcast is a documented stub (real on-chain ctf redeem needs go-ethereum + Polygon RPC, wired in v0.2); the default --dry-run produces the exact call set you can replay through the official Polymarket Rust CLI for live broadcast.
